name: Preparatory English 2
description:
The course provides a space for the students to practice select sub-skills and build
communicative competence with the help of hands-on activities and tasks. Students will engage
in structured writing tasks, including CVs, emails, and essays, to enhance their ability to write
clearly, accurately, and appropriately for different purposes and audiences. To enhance speaking
skills, the course will focus on context-specific speaking activities, such as debates, group
discussions, presentations, and role plays to strengthen fluency and confidence in
communication.
